French High Schoolers Protest, Clashes Erupt with Riot Police

High school students across France have been protesting, leading to clashes with riot police. Le Monde highlighted concerns that with minors involved, maintaining public order should prioritize avoiding serious injury. The Macron government is reportedly struggling to quell these demonstrations.
